name: John Muir
role: Scottish-American naturalist, writer and Sierra Club founder (1838–1914)
summary: Muir was a naturalist and writer who argued for preserving wilderness, forests and national parks under federal protection, and treated animals and plants as having worth in themselves. His published books rarely address other political questions, so most quiz statements have no recorded position.
